messages:
maria: quick heads-up — I pushed follow-ups to PR #4824 (runtime/batching). Addressed the reviewer comments about batch sizing and a flaky unit test. PTAL when you have a minute. Notes below and CI is green except a flaky macOS job we can ignore for this change.

maria: summary of what changed:
- lowered default batch size to 16 for short-seq paths
- added a heuristic to avoid batching tiny requests together (config flag: enable_small_request_guard)
- fixed a race in kv-cache test by adding a retry hook
- updated changelog and added a smoke test that exercises short-seq latency

maria: diff excerpt:
```
diff --git a/runtime/batcher.go b/runtime/batcher.go
@@ -120,7 +120,10 @@ func chooseBatchSize(reqLen int) int {
-    return 64
+    if reqLen < 32 && cfg.EnableSmallRequestGuard {
+        return 16
+    }
+    return 64
 }
```

maria: CI: build ✅, unit tests ✅, integration ✅, macos-flaky ❌ (flaky infra, not related). Scheduling note: would like to canary this Tue morning; need two approvals for an oncall merge window.

sam: skimmed the diff — makes sense. can you add a short comment on why 16 vs 8/32? just to capture the tradeoff.

maria: yup — added comment and a small comment in CHANGELOG explaining rationale (empirically 16 reduced p95 for short requests in our benchmarks).

jay: left two tiny nits inline: one formatting and one var name. not blocking.

maria: both nits addressed and pushed. thanks.

sarah: re-requesting review — ptal @sam @jay when you get a sec. I want to make sure we have both approvals before Tue canary. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: LGTM, ran the smoke locally quickly. :+1:

jay: looks good to me too. approved.

ci-bot: deploy-check — all required checks passed. merge queue clear.

maria: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll land right before the Tue morning canary window and tag the canary note. If anything unexpected pops up I'll revert.

sarah: thanks for the quick turnaround. I'll add this to canary checklist. :white_check_mark:
